name: EngineAI SE01
summary: SE01 is EngineAI's first full-size humanoid, 170 cm tall with 32 DoF. The company presented it as the first humanoid with a natural, human-like walking gait, trained with an end-to-end neural network. It is mainly a technology showcase that led to the later PM01 and T800.
highlights: Joint torque up to 330 N·m, per launch coverage.
Gait is trained with an end-to-end neural network to take long, human-like strides.
caveats: No official price; reseller prices online vary and were not verified.
Most public footage is company-produced walking demos.

sources.title: EngineAI Unveils SE01, an Impressive Robot the Walks Like a Human
